nodes.name: Settings
nodes.notes: Edit here: status URL, alert recipient and sender, server name, reminder interval, optional Slack/Discord incoming-webhook URL (leave empty for email only).

nodes.name: GET /status
nodes.notes: Header Auth credential "CX PGSQL health token": name Authorization, value "Bearer <token>". Non-2xx answers are passed on (never error); network errors are passed on as an error item.

nodes.name: Post to chat webhook
nodes.notes: Slack incoming webhooks take {"text"}; Discord webhooks take {"content"} (chosen by the URL).
